intro_en: You will learn to explain khöömii (Mongolian throat singing) to a foreign friend, and to make vivid comparisons with -сан мэт and -х мэт in Mongolian and 'as though', 'as if' and 'like' in English.
intro_mn: Та гадаадын найздаа хөөмийг хэрхэн тайлбарлахыг, мөн -сан мэт, -х мэт дүрслэлийг Монгол хэлээр, 'as though', 'as if', 'like'-ийг англи хэлээр хэрхэн хэрэглэхийг сурна.

vocab.example_en: Khöömii is a special Mongolian art.
A khöömii singer holds his breath for a long time.
The timbre of the voice is amazing.
He is singing khöömii in the mountains.
The overtone can be heard clearly.
Traditional khöömii is connected to nature.

vocab.example_mn: Танхим чичирч байгаа юм шиг санагдлаа.
vocab.example_en: It felt as if the hall was vibrating.

sentences.mn: Хөөмий сонсоход надад уул чимээгээр хариулсан мэт санагдсан.
sentences.en: Listening to khöömii, I felt as though the mountain had answered in sound.
alt_en: When I listened to khöömii, it felt as if the mountain had answered with sound.
sentences.mn_latin: Khöömii sonsokhod nadad uul chimeegeer khariulsan met sanagdsan.

sentences.mn: Тэр нэг хоолойгоор хоёр дуу гаргаж байгаа мэт сонсогдоно.
sentences.en: It sounds as though he is producing two sounds with one voice.
alt_en: It sounds as if he is making two sounds with one voice.
sentences.mn_latin: Ter neg khooloigoor khoyor duu gargaj baigaa met sonsogdono.

sentences.mn: Хөөмийчин амьсгалаа удаан барьж, хоолойгоо чангалдаг.
sentences.en: The khöömii singer holds his breath for a long time and tightens his throat.
alt_en: A khöömii singer holds his breath a long time and tightens his throat.
sentences.mn_latin: Khöömiichin amisgalaa udaan barij, khooloigoo changaldag.

sentences.mn: Түүний дуу урсах гол мэт зөөлөн сонсогдов.
sentences.en: His song sounded as soft as a flowing river.
alt_en: His song sounded soft, like a flowing river.
sentences.mn_latin: Tüünii duu ursakh gol met zöölön sonsogdov.

sentences.mn: Давхар дуу нь исгэрэх салхи шиг сонсогддог.
sentences.en: The overtone sounds like a whistling wind.
sentences.mn_latin: Davkhar duu ni isgerekh salkhi shig sonsogddog.

sentences.mn: Орчин үеийн хамтлаг хөөмийг рок хөгжимтэй хольдог.
sentences.en: A modern band mixes khöömii with rock music.
alt_en: A contemporary band blends khöömii with rock music.
sentences.mn_latin: Orchin üyeiin khamtlag khöömiig rok khögjimtei kholidog.

sentences.mn: Түүнийг хөөмийлөх үед дэлхийн бүх чимээ намжсан мэт болдог.
sentences.en: When he sings khöömii, it is as though all the noise in the world has quieted.
alt_en: When he sings khöömii, it's as if all the world's noise has died down.
sentences.mn_latin: Tüüniig khöömiilökh üyed delkhiin bükh chimee namjsan met boldog.

sentences.mn: Тэр ярихаа больж, яг л дуулах гэж байгаа мэт харагдсан.
sentences.en: He stopped talking and looked as though he were about to sing.
alt_en: He stopped talking and looked as if he was about to sing.
sentences.mn_latin: Ter yarikhaa bolij, yag l duulakh gej baigaa met kharagdsan.

sentences.mn: Хоолой нь чичирч, танхим бүхэлдээ дуулж байгаа юм шиг санагдсан.
sentences.en: His voice vibrated, and it felt as if the whole hall were singing.
alt_en: His voice trembled, and the whole hall seemed to be singing.
sentences.mn_latin: Khooloi ni chichirch, tankhim bükheldee duulj baigaa yum shig sanagdsan.

sentences.mn: Энэ өнгө аяс миний чихэнд мөнгөн хонх дуугарсан мэт сонсогдов.
sentences.en: This timbre sounded to my ears as though a silver bell had rung.
alt_en: This timbre sounded in my ears as if a silver bell had rung.
sentences.mn_latin: Ene öngö ayas minii chikhend möngön khonkh duugarsan met sonsogdov.

sentences.mn: Тэр хөөмийг хэдэн жил сурсан ч хараахан эзэмшээгүй мэт биеэ авч явдаг.
sentences.en: He has studied khöömii for years, yet he acts as though he has not mastered it.
alt_en: He has studied khöömii for years, but he behaves as if he hasn't mastered it yet.
sentences.mn_latin: Ter khöömiig kheden jil sursan ch kharaakhan ezemsheegüi met biyee avch yavdag.

grammar.explain_en: Add мэт after a verb to say 'as though'. Past -сан мэт describes something that seems to have already happened: уул хариулсан мэт 'as though the mountain had answered'. Present or future -х мэт / -аж байгаа мэт describes something that seems to be happening or about to happen: дуулах мэт 'as if about to sing'. Мэт can also follow a noun, but шиг is often used for simple likeness. Note that the comparison is a feeling, not a fact.
grammar.explain_mn: Англи хэлэнд 'as though' ба 'as if' бараг адил утгатай бөгөөд бодит бус мэт санагдах зүйлийг хэлнэ: It sounds as though he is singing. Өнгөрсөн үйл болсон мэт бол had + V3 ашиглана: as though the mountain had answered. Одоо ч үнэн биш зүйлд заримдаа were хэрэглэнэ: as if he were a bird. 'Like' нь голдуу нэр үгийн өмнө ордог энгийн харьцуулалт: like the wind. Яриан дунд like-ийг as if-ийн оронд хэрэглэх нь бий ч, албан бичигт as though / as if илүү тохиромжтой.

examples.mn: Тэр шувуу болох гэж байгаа мэт дуулав.
examples.en: He sang as if he were about to become a bird.
examples.mn_latin: Ter shuvuu bolokh gej baigaa met duulav.

examples.en: His voice sounded like the wind.
It seemed as though the hall had fallen silent.

dialogue.speaker: Bat
dialogue.mn: Хөөмийчин амьсгалаа барьж, хоолойгоо чангалаад давхар дуу гаргадаг.
dialogue.en: The singer holds his breath, tightens his throat and produces an overtone.
dialogue.mn_latin: Khöömiichin amisgalaa barij, khooloigoo changalaad davkhar duu gargadag.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.mn: Нэг хүн хоёр хоолойгоор дуулж байгаа мэт сонсогдож байна!
dialogue.en: It sounds as though one person is singing with two voices!
dialogue.mn_latin: Neg khün khoyor khooloigoor duulj baigaa met sonsogdoj baina!

dialogue.speaker: Bat
dialogue.mn: Тийм ээ. Уламжлалт хөөмий нь ус, салхи, уулыг дуурайдаг.
dialogue.en: Yes. Traditional khöömii imitates water, wind and mountains.
dialogue.mn_latin: Tiim ee. Ulamjlalt khöömii ni us, salkhi, uulyg duuraidag.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.mn: Харин тайзан дээрх хамтлаг арай өөр юм байна.
dialogue.en: But the band on stage is a bit different.
dialogue.mn_latin: Kharin taizan deerkh khamtlag arai öör yum baina.

dialogue.speaker: Bat
dialogue.mn: Тэд орчин үеийн хөгжимтэй хольдог. Гэхдээ хоолой нь яг л уулын цуурай шиг сонсогддог.
dialogue.en: They mix it with modern music. But the voice sounds just like a mountain echo.
dialogue.mn_latin: Ted orchin üyeiin khögjimtei kholidog. Gekhdee khooloi ni yag l uulyn tsuurai shig sonsogddog.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.mn: Би цээжиндээ чичиргээ мэдэрч байна. Танхим бүхэлдээ дуулж байгаа юм шиг!
dialogue.en: I feel a vibration in my chest. It's as if the whole hall is singing!
dialogue.mn_latin: Bi tseejindee chichirgee mederch baina. Tankhim bükheldee duulj baigaa yum shig!

dialogue.speaker: Bat
dialogue.mn: Яг тийм. Хөөмийг чихээр бус бүх биеэрээ сонсдог гэдэг.
dialogue.en: Exactly. They say you hear khöömii not with your ears but with your whole body.
dialogue.mn_latin: Yag tiim. Khöömiig chikheer bus bükh biyeeree sonsdog gedeg.

culture_note.en: Khöömii is a Mongolian throat-singing tradition in which one singer produces a low drone and a higher whistling overtone at the same time. It is closely tied to nature and was traditionally said to imitate mountains, rivers and wind. UNESCO has recognized Mongolian khöömii as intangible cultural heritage, and today it is heard both in folk concerts and in modern bands.
culture_note.mn: Хөөмий бол нэг дуучин нэгэн зэрэг нам дуу болон дээд давхар исгэрэх дуу гаргадаг монголчуудын уламжлалт урлаг юм. Энэ нь байгальтай нягт холбоотой бөгөөд уул, гол, салхины чимээг дуурайдаг гэж үздэг. ЮНЕСКО-гоос хөөмийг соёлын биет бус өвөөр хүлээн зөвшөөрсөн бөгөөд өнөө үед уламжлалт тоглолт болон орчин үеийн хамтлагуудын хөгжимд аль алинд нь сонсогддог.
